static_traits.name: Li Jie
static_traits.family_status: Father once worked at GE; the rest not mentioned
static_traits.social_status: Has one close friend to confide in, but has not yet shared this belief with them; deep connection affected
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy received in the past
static_traits.language_features: Slightly nervous but cooperative at first meeting; clear expression, able to reflect; cautious tone, good cooperation

basic_info.main_problem: I believe animals don't return my love for them, which leaves me feeling rejected and lonely; more prominent in the past year, especially after adopting a pet dog.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize this belief has affected my emotional health and want to work on and change it together with the counselor.
growth_experiences: Long felt unloved in childhood, seen by the client as the root of the current 'unloved' belief; the feeling has existed since I can remember, becoming more prominent in the past year after adopting a pet dog.

core_beliefs: I am not worthy of being loved
Others (including animals) don't truly care about me

special_situations.event: After adopting a pet dog, feels the dog's reactions in daily interactions are flat or independent
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the other doesn't show sustained, clear intimate response, it means he doesn't love me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Investing lots of time in companionship and goodwill, while psychologically presetting not being loved to lower disappointment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He (the dog) doesn't care about me / doesn't love me

special_situations.event: When the pet dog shows possible affiliative behaviors such as tail-wagging or snuggling
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only explicit signs matching my expectations count as 'love'; other positive signs don't count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Interprets positive signals as habit or conditioned reflex to avoid holding expectations
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This is just habit, not love

special_situations.event: Being with a close friend, thinking about sharing this belief of one's own
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I expose vulnerability, I will be judged and rejected
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Staying silent, avoiding self-disclosure for self-protection
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He'll think I am strange / not normal

special_situations.event: Thinks of pursuing a singer dream and facing evaluations by others/the audience
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Without others' appreciation, it proves I have no value
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-doubt, reducing attempts to avoid being rejected
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No one will appreciate my singing

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be loved, accepted, and to build intimate connections with others (including animals)
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being rejected, being judged, love going unanswered
defense_goal: Reduces the possibility of being hurt by lowering expectations and keeping emotional guard up
Gaining control and safety by presetting 'the other doesn't care'

object_relations.self_representation: Unloved self, liable to be ignored at any time
object_relations.object_representation: Cold, judgmental, unresponsive others (animals / friends / audience)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When needing to bare vulnerability and needs to significant others (such as close friends or the counselor)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The other will judge or reject me like people in the past (projecting early 'unloved' experiences onto present relationships)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Cautious and evasive in tone, reduces disclosure of details; self-mocks or downplays in advance to reduce the risk of being judged.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When noticing the pet dog showing affectionate signals (such as wagging its tail, snuggling)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Understanding the other's approach as meaningless habit, to avoid admitting being needed and loved
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using rationalizing language (e.g. 'just a conditioned reflex / habit') to dilute emotion and the need for closeness.

manifestations: Repeatedly experiencing 'the other doesn't love me' in interactions with animals
Not expressing myself to my close friend for fear of judgment
Expecting no appreciation for my singer dream
outcomes: Persistent loneliness and experiences of being rejected
Decreased motivation, less investment in loved activities
Avoids self-disclosure and attempts; relationship intimacy is limited
Career pursuits affected, inner increased self-doubt

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the urge to express or make requests toward other people or things, redirects the energy toward the self, and avoids seeking outward.
manifestations: Not sharing core beliefs with my close friend, choosing to digest the pain alone
Holding back true needs in the relationship

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: Presuming friends will think me 'weird / not normal'
Projecting the 'I won't be loved' belief onto animals and others
Presuming audiences won't appreciate when pursuing the singer dream

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-reflection and self-limitation, overly cautious, accompanied by harsh self-criticism.
manifestations: At the first meeting, expressing 'a bit nervous', wording cautious (transference: projection)
Strict self-evaluation; worries about being judged by others
Clearly restrained when expressing needs and emotions

positive_force: Has a close friend to confide in (potential support can be activated)
Willing to seek help and accept exploration and behavioral experiments
Love for animals and continued devotion
Able to notice the dog's positive signals (such as wagging its tail, cuddling)
Has a clear career vision and passion (wants to become a singer)
negative_force: The negative core belief 'I am unloved' is deeply rooted
Mind reading and presumed rejection (Jumping to conclusions: mind reading)
Over-reliance on external recognition, worrying about no one appreciating
Fear of judgment leads to avoiding self-disclosure and proactive attempts

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding self-disclosure in interpersonal interactions (especially not discussing core beliefs with my close friend)
antecedent: When with close friends, thinks of sharing own beliefs and feelings
target_behavior.core_reason: Childhood 'unloved' experiences internalized into belief, causing fear of judgment and rejection
target_behavior.function: Escaping potential shame and experiences of being rejected, relieving anxiety short-term
target_behavior.consequence: Limited relationship depth, reduced closeness, worsened loneliness and sense of being rejected

target_behavior.behavior: When interacting with the pet dog, negatively interprets positive signals and immerses in rejection emotions
antecedent: The dog's neutral or affectionate behaviors (such as tail-wagging, snuggling)
Recalling the dog's indifferent moments when being alone
target_behavior.core_reason: The core belief 'I am unloved' and mind-reading tendencies reinforcing negative interpretation
target_behavior.function: Self-protecting by lowering expectations and disqualifying positive evidence, avoiding disappointment
target_behavior.consequence: Fewer positive interaction experiences, worsened sadness and loneliness, reduced satisfaction from pet ownership

target_behavior.behavior: Self-doubt in singing pursuits, reducing public performances or high-exposure practice
antecedent: Thinking about others' / the audience's judgment of the singing
When facing opportunities to try or perform
target_behavior.core_reason: Expecting no appreciation, over-relying on external recognition, fearing failure and rejection
target_behavior.function: Avoids potential negative evaluation to maintain short-term emotional stability
